answer.content:
I completely understand the rush, Isabella. Unfortunately, for your account security, I can only verify your identity (and then access your gift card balance) using one of two methods:

1. A valid email address associated with your account, or
2. Your first name, last name, and zip code.

Since the email address you provided wasn't found in our system and there's no other way to look up your account, I'll need your zip code to proceed. There isn't an alternative authentication method available on our end.

If you can locate your zip code (for example, it's often listed on a past order confirmation, shipping label, or your account profile), just share it and I'll get your gift card balance pulled up right away for you!
